elements.label: Figure 3.3
elements.title: Countries with higher levels of quality infrastructure tend to perform better economically
elements.content: Chart type: Scatter plot with two panels (a. Exports, b. GDP per capita) showing positive correlations fitted with red trend lines. Panel a. Exports: Y-axis is 'Average total annual exports of goods and services, 2016-22 (current US$, log scale)' ranging from 17 to 29; X-axis is 'Global Quality Infrastructure Index score, 2023' ranging from 0 to 1.0. Panel b. GDP per capita: Y-axis is 'GDP per capita, 2022 (current US$, log scale)' ranging from 5 to 13; X-axis is 'Global Quality Infrastructure Index score, 2023' ranging from 0 to 1.0. Sources: WDR 2025 team, based on data from GQII 2023 (dashboard), Global Quality Infrastructure Index (GQII) Program, Mesopartner and Analyticar, https://gqii.org/gqii-2023/; World Bank.
